title: Saudi Chestnut Tagine
description: A flavorful and hearty tagine made with saudi spices, aromatic ingredients, and tender chestnuts. This dish is a staple of Saudi cuisine.

ingredients.name: Aromatic Spices
ingredients.notes: Combine ground cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and turmeric

ingredients.name: Saudi Spices
ingredients.notes: Combine ground black pepper, cayenne pepper, and ground cardamom

ingredients.name: Tagine
ingredients.notes: A traditional Saudi clay pot or ceramic dish

instructions: Rinse the chestnuts and peel them if necessary.
In the tagine, combine the aromatic spices and saudi spices.
Add the chestnuts to the tagine and pour in the water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the chestnuts are tender.
Season with salt to taste, then serve hot.
